name: smwblocks-custom-exit-enabled-pipes-specific-screen-conditional-random
title: Custom Exit Enabled Pipes (Specific Screen + Conditional + Random)
description:
Replicas of the horizontal and vertical exit enabled pipes with the following functionalities:

  • specific_screen: Uses a specified screen exit instead of the current screen's exit.
  • conditional: Uses specified screen exits depending on the value of a RAM address. Different screen exits can be specified for multiple ranges of the RAM address.
  • random: Rolls a random screen exit from a list.

Check the .asm files for details on how to set them up.
